content: {"praised": ["Acting by Hsiao Hou, Kara Hui, and Lau Kar‑Leung is spectacular.", "Story premise of a young girl saving a martial arts school is engaging.", "Fight scenes are well choreographed and exciting.", "Humor blends well with action for a light tone.", "Movie feels timeless and underrated compared to other 80s kung‑fu films."], "criticized": ["Cutesy humor and long song‑dance numbers feel excessive.", "Slapstick comedy may be off‑putting for some viewers.", "Tone can be too comedic for those seeking serious martial arts.", "Some find the pacing difficult to stomach.", "Overall quality described as terrible by a few reviewers."]}
